question: Which office holds the register of bargaining units and worksites (certification number, body and dates, chief steward, bargaining chair, composition, site manager contact), which of those fields may a member who is not a steward or officer read, who may create, change and archive a register row, and must every employer, worksite and steward identifier a row names be verified as belonging to the same organization?
decision: The org's officers hold the register; admins and officers create, change and archive rows. Members read unit name, worksite name and address, and the chief steward's name and work contact only. Certification number, board dates, composition and site manager contact are steward-and-above. Every referenced employer, worksite and steward id must belong to the same org, enforced on the server and by a database constraint.
